description: UN World Population Prospects 2024 Revision, Standard Projections, CSV format. Acquired to close gap G-1 and replace the hand-typed ASFR table as the ASFR basis.
retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS download from population.un.org/wpp assets, Standard Projections CSV files. Open data, no access request required.
transform_note: Filtered to LocTypeName='Country/Area' with a 3-letter ISO3 code, age groups 15-49, variants Medium plus Lower/Upper 95 PI. Estimates (Time<=2023) classified OBSERVED; projections (Time>=2024) classified DERIVED.

files.note: 6481890 raw rows across 18 variants; ingest keeps Medium + 95% PI for 237 countries x 151 years x 7 age groups = 250509 canonical rows.
Only the TFR column is ingested, independently of the ASFR file, so the accounting identity stays a test rather than a tautology. 35787 canonical rows.
